heading.en: Transfer to Corporation of property, rights and liabilities of Prime Minister

text.en:
(1) On the commencement of this Order, all property, rights and liabilities of the Prime Minister Corporation except otherwise excluded by an order made by the Minister thereof shall be transferred to and vest in the Corporation without further assurance, act or deed except otherwise provided in this Order.

(2) The Minister shall have power to do all acts or things as he considers or expedient for giving effect to and carrying out the provisions of

(1).

(3) If any question arises as to whether any particular property, right or been transferred to and vested in the Corporation under (1 J, a certificate under the hand of the Minister shall be conclusive that the property, right or liability was or was not so transferred or

(4) Any immovable property to be transferred to and vested in the under subsection (1) shall be held by the Corporation upon such tenure and subject to such conditions as the Minister may determine.

(5) Any proceedings by or against the Prime Minister Corporation which are pending on the commencement of this Order may be continued, completed and enforced by or against the Corporation.

(6) Any agreement made, transaction effected or other thing done by, to or in relation to the Prime Minister Corporation which is in force or effective immediately before the commencement of this Order shall have effect as from the of this Order as if made, effected or done by, to or in relation to the Corporation, in all respects as if the Corporation were the same person, in law, as the Prime Minister Corporation.

(7) For the purposes of subsection (6), references to the Prime Minister {a} in any agreement (whether or not in writing) and in any deed, bond· or instrument; {b} in any process or other document issued, prepared or employed for the purpose of any proceeding before any court or other tribunal or and {c} in any other document whatever relating to or affecting any property, right or liability of the Prime Minister Corporation which vests by virtue of subsection ( 1) in the Corporation, shall be taken, regardless of any implied or express provision to the contrary, from the commencement date appointed by the Minister under section 1(1), as referring to the Corporation.

(8) It is hereby declared for avoidance of doubt that - {a} any reference in this Order to property vested in the Prime Minister Corporation is a reference to such property of the Prime Minister whether situated in Brunei Darussalam or elsewhere whether or not capable of being transferred or assigned to the Prime Minister and (b} any reference to the rights and liabilities of the Prime Minister Corporation is a reference to such rights to which the Prime Minister Corporation is entitled or, as the case may be, such liabilities to which the Prime Minister Corporation is subject, whether under the laws of Brunei any country or territory outside Brunei Darussalam and or not capable of being transferred or assigned to the Corporation and includes rights ;:j_nd liabilities arising under loans raised by the Prime Minister Corporation. of property, rights and liabilities of specified companies in a holding company.

heading.en: Vesting of property, rights and liabilities of specified companies in a holding

text.en:

Transitional and saving provisions.

The Minister may by order make such transitional and saving provision as him necessary or expedient in connection with the commencement of this Order and any provision of an order made under this section after the of this Order may be made so as to have effect as from that or any later day. heading.en: Consequential amendments to the Brunei National Petroleum Company

text.en:
Upon the commencement of this Order, the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad Order, 2002 (S 6/2002) is amended by deleting "Prime Minister Corporation" and substituting 11Minister for Finance Corporation" they occur in the following sections (a} section 5(2); fbJ section 7(4);
